shorts.title: GTA 6: How to Get More Health
shorts.description:
Strength raises max health and Cardio raises stamina in GTA 6. Finish every workout and train Jason and Lucia separately.
Gym or no gym? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: How to Switch Jason and Lucia
shorts.description:
Hold right on the D-pad for the partner menu, then press R1 or RB. Switching unlocks with the story, and J or L missions are one character only.
Team Jason or team Lucia? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6: How to Keep a Stolen Car
shorts.description:
Unregistered cars can disappear in GTA 6. From Chapter 2, take an untracked car to Moses' garage, respray it and pick Register.
What's your ride? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
